entities.name: Bacterial GlmU
observations: Bifunctional enzyme catalyzing the final two reactions of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis.
C-terminal acetyltransferase activity: alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + acetyl-CoA → N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + CoA + H+.
N-terminal uridyltransferase activity: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP + H+ → UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + diphosphate.
Sequence is 469 aa and matches reviewed GlmU references at 50.9–62.1% identity with 96.2–97.7% query coverage; annotation transfer is homology-supported, not direct assay evidence for the query.
